name: tia_import_block
description: Import or update a PLC block from SimaticML XML. OB attributes CyclicTime and PhaseOffset in SimaticML are microseconds (100 ms = <CyclicTime>100000</CyclicTime>); there is no 'PhaseShift' attribute. The XML is imported unchanged; suspicious OB settings are listed as warnings after the result text, and the cycle settings TIA stored for imported cyclic interrupt OBs are read back.

xml_content.description: The SimaticML XML string containing the block definition.

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC (optional, defaults to first PLC).

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing block if it exists (default true).

folder.description: Target group folder path for the block (optional).
